void UnarySinUGenInternalK::processBlock ( bool &  shouldDelete,
const unsigned int  blockID,
const int  channel 
) throw () [virtual]

Process a block of samples for this blockID and channel.

This is the main rendering function and needs to be implement by all subclasses.

Parameters:
shouldDelete A UGen graph can be scheduled for deletion by setting this to true on return. If it is already true it should NOT be set to false.
blockID This is a sample counter, you can assume that calls to this function will have blockIDs which are higher that the last call (until the maximum integer is reached).
channel The channel index to process.
